extraction.description: Full original passage text, title and section headings transcribed against rendered printed pages 4-5. Introductory Madagascar box placed before body prose in visual reading order (pypdf emits it last). Line wrapping joined; NBSP rendered as ordinary space. Original dash retained. Added [Page 4] and [Page 5] location markers. No sentence simplification, answer annotations, or selected evidence spans.
extraction.visual_checks: Passage pages 4-5, question page 5 and official rubric page 11 rendered using pdftoppm and visually inspected.
extraction.condition: text-only adaptation, not original visual examination administration

exposure: The preparation agent opened whole 2024 question and mark-scheme PDFs through web retrieval, including items from other passages. The whole 2024 paper is development-exposed and cannot be reserved evidence. No other year or protected R5/R6 data was opened. No pretrained LLM enters the evaluated learner; developer LLM exposure does not establish contamination-free future hybrid evaluation.
